verdict: A rank-one off-diagonal correction is algebraically necessary and sufficient to promote the continued core null direction to a full magnetic kernel. Such corrections form a two-dimensional affine selector torsor. The desired kernel fixes only K(v), not K on complementary source directions; choosing a portal therefore still requires an independent source constructor.
